race.description: Duttons Easy To Do Business With! Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: DURHAM (3) makes life hard for himself by settling back in his races, but is normally running on very strongly, as he did when finishing runner-up by a neck at Warracknabeal just over 2 weeks ago. His only win came here 3 starts back, and with 3kg less to carry this time, he could have the last say. BIT OF A REBEL (1) is a durable veteran on good tracks, and he should get conditions that are more suitable this time. An extra 200m is ideal, and he has each-way claims again. PRICKLY POPPY (12) was an upset winner on a really heavy track 2 starts back at Morphettville Parks and then was well beaten in a far stronger field on the classic course there nearly 6 weeks ago. Stick with her here. CHARTIN (6) posted a rare win here 3 weeks ago in a slightly higher class, and he always saves his best for this circuit. He is up in weight, but another honest effort is expected. TRIORA (10) had an excuse when a beaten favourite at Murtoa last time out. Freshened, and is not out of this. Include.
